Accelerate both PNR and direct click sampling with audited native cores

Add safeguarded Newton survival inversion and FP64 CUDA signed-branch trajectories. Replay all 4M historical PNR records unchanged with 3.176/3.354x measured CPU speedups.

Benchmark official Frugal CUDA FP32 and FP64 cores with a disclosed Windows host-layout compatibility patch, retaining four failed builds. Record 0.284143 s per 512 large-panel four-branch samples, and Frugal small-system advantages without an equal-quality large-system claim.

Validation: 1871 independent checks; full suite 851 run, 822 passed, zero failures/errors; ten new native interface tests.
